ultraTerrainRepair.diagnosis: Ultra terrain exceeded MAX_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS(16). Physical sky adds one sampler and Ultra has three directional shadow samplers, putting the old full terrain shader at 17. Failed program links explain missing ground; weather was not the cause.
ultraTerrainRepair.change: Pack the two independently positioned night-light histories into two scissored halves of one RGBA8 render target and bind one sampler. Same pixel resolution, history blending and byte budget. Preserve the physical sky, relief, colour reference, LOD blending and all three Ultra cascades.
